No Certificate of Achievement section is printed, so no blocks, total, outcomes or careers are recorded for the certificate. A reviewer should find the certificate's own catalog page.

For reference, the A.S. section states 28.0-29.0 major units. It has four parts. Required (15 units): MACH 357 (2), MACH 205 (2), MACH 206 (3), MACH 207 (3), MACH 208 (2), WELD 200 (3). Choose 4-5 units: MACH 200D (4) or MACH 200E (5). Required (6 units): MACH 201 (3), MACH 202 (3). Electives (3 units): WELD 206 (3) or MACH 209 (3).
MACH 207 (CNC Mill Programming, 3 units) appears in the A.S. section but is not in the closed list.
